name: Slot refund 0x2dad6442 pays out before clearing the slot, allowing reentrancy
summary: The unverified contract's function 0x2dad6442 refunds a slot opened with unlockSlot(uint256) by sending its 0.6 BNB price to the caller before marking the slot closed. The attacker opened slot 3 for 0.6 BNB and re-entered the refund from its receive hook 18 times, taking 10.8 BNB; a copycat took the remaining 0.41 BNB the same way.
notes: Loss is the contract's whole 10.61 BNB balance, slot payments left unrefunded after the owner wound the project down in July 2021; the attacker's own 0.6 BNB and the copycat's 0.79 BNB top-up are netted out. The owner's 0x0663dbdd call (block 9204958) cleared slot 0x5 (201600 since the constructor) minutes before users began taking refunds; it governs when a refund may be taken, not the missing reentrancy guard, so the deployment two days earlier is the reset. The victim's internal transactions show no other transaction paying more than one refund.
